11. Application of existing laws. – Where any tax, cess or surcharge imposed

12. Bar of suits in Civil Courts. – No suit shall lie in any Civil Court to set aside 
or modify any assessment, levy or collection of a tax, duty, cess or surcharge made 
under this Ordinance and the rules thereunder or any penalty imposed under sub -
section (2) of section 3.
